facts.text: Waterworks Road on the UNH campus is the site of the UNH/Durham water treatment plant, which replaced the 1935 Arthur Rollins plant in 2020.

verdict: An unidentified building beside the water treatment plant; neither its use nor its age could be confirmed.
notes: Could not identify this building. A web search for the address found no records. notunh's gazetteer places it about 50 m east of the treatment plant. One possibility is the surviving 1935 Arthur Rollins plant or a related utility building, but that is unverified: a 2017 town planner review reportedly planned demolition of the old plant, and I could not open it (404). The category "support" is a placeholder. Suggest checking Durham's assessor (VGSI) or a UNH facilities map. No photos.
